newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse thin, fridge maker resumes trade.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse thin, fridge maker resumes trade.

text.p: First-tier refrigerator maker Arctic, which rejoined trading on Bucharest bourse on Friday after being suspended for more than a month, rose sharply after drawing most of the early attention.
"Arctic was the star of the day, with many buyers running after it in early trading," one broker said. He said that Arctic opened at 3,700 lei and quickly rose to 4,700 under buying pressure.
"After it touched 4,700, sellers stepped into the market with important orders and some made nice profits," another said. Arctic closed at 3,200 lei.

Brokers expected it to stay steady in coming days before rising to 4,000 sometime next week. Arctic's turnover was 9.6 billion lei, more than half overall turnover of 15.6 billion -- up from 7.41 billion at the last session.
Other first and second-tier listings faced thin interest from investors on Friday.
Brokers forecast only slight changes for Monday, with the market remaining stable for the rest of the week.

Two independent market indices, the VAB, and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched up by 0.25 and 0.23 percent respectively from Thursday. Another ideperndent index the BIG was not immediately available.
